title: T-010 Retrieval Builder orientation
summary: The isolated Retrieval Builder completed its bounded orientation under workspace-only Linux confinement using the existing Claude Max subscription.
evidence: The report verified 26,559 canonical content chunks and database integrity.
The worktree retained no Git remote and only reports/orientation-report.json was added.
The sanitized database contained no operational user, question, feedback, beta-tester, affiliate, or referral-contact data.
No production connection, commit, push, deployment, web search, or web fetch occurred.
The successful run was subscription-included and incurred no metered Anthropic API billing.
The report identified missing side indexes and correctly documented lexical fallback as the current retrieval path.
The sanitized JSON report is published at /orientation-reports/T-010/orientation-report.json.
limitations: This orientation does not authorize implementation. Original side indexes remain absent, and build work requires an independent Claude GO instruction.
